label: Total-cause containment and q.4 a.2 preexistence are independent on finite grades frames
paraphrase: Closed mathematical control over two finite grades frames (two beings, two respects, false the respect of being). In the first, a cause of a perfection other than being lacks that perfection and nothing causes anything's being: q.4 a.2 preexistence holds vacuously and total-cause containment fails. In the second, a cause of a thing's being, total only in being and partial in the other perfection, lacks that other perfection: total-cause containment holds and preexistence fails. Statements about these interpretations only, not that such causes exist.
